description: Get upcoming (or a specific title's) episode air times, soonest-airing first (confirmed live). Omit `mediaId` for the site-wide upcoming schedule, or pass it (from search_media/get_media) to get one title's next-episode air time. Anime only — manga has no airing schedule; a manga id (like any non-anime id) is rejected as not-found rather than silently returning an empty schedule, though that error reads the same as a nonexistent id and doesn't single out the manga/anime mismatch.

mediaId.description: Restrict to this AniList anime ID (not manga).

notYetAired.description: Set false to instead list only already-aired episodes (confirmed live: this swaps to a past-only result set, it doesn't add past episodes to the still-upcoming ones).

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 50, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

name: get_anime_schedule
title: Get the anime airing schedule
